workloads.name: core/loop
workloads.source:
-- A counting loop: the cost of the loop itself and integer addition.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  put 0 into i
  repeat while i < n
    add 1 to i
    add i to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: core/fib
workloads.source:
-- Naive recursive Fibonacci: function calls, comparison and subtraction.
function fib n
  if n < 2 then return n
  return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
end fib

on run n
  return fib(n)
end run

workloads.name: numbers/add
workloads.source:
-- Exact fractional additions; scale the checksum to an integer.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    add 0.125 to total
  end repeat
  return round(total * 8, 0)
end run

workloads.name: numbers/multiply
workloads.source:
-- Exact fractional products with increasing operands.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    add 1.25 * i to total
  end repeat
  return round(total * 8, 0)
end run

workloads.name: numbers/divide
workloads.source:
-- Exact fractional division with increasing operands.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    add i / 8 to total
  end repeat
  return round(total * 8, 0)
end run

workloads.name: numbers/quantity
workloads.source:
-- Convert millimetres to metres, then remove the unit for the checksum.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put (i * 1000 mm) as m into distance
    add distance / 1 m to total
  end repeat
  return round(total, 0)
end run

workloads.name: text/index
workloads.source:
-- Index ASCII Characters, cycling through the input.
on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    if character (i mod 16 + 1) of "NorthTalk rocks!" = "o" then add 1 to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: collections/list-build
workloads.source:
-- Build a List with collecting, then iterate it for a checksum.
on run n
  repeat for each i in 1..n collecting i into values
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each v in values
    add v to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: macro/transform
workloads.source:
-- Transform record rows into invoice amounts, then aggregate them.
on run n
  repeat for each i in 1..n collecting {price: i, quantity: 2} into rows
  end repeat
  repeat for each row in rows collecting row's price * row's quantity into amounts
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each amount in amounts
    add amount to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run

workloads.name: lifecycle/restore

skip.peers: NorthTalk embedding API; no peer counterpart.
skip.zig: The native benchmark Host does not yet install restore bindings; this is a runner limitation, not a Core limitation.

workloads.source:
-- The `restore` Host fills the rows once, then each Run saves the Group,
-- restores it, and delivers `run` to the restored Script, which reads them.
script variable rows = []

on fill n
  put [] into rows
  repeat for each i in 1..n
    put {id: i, name: "row " & i, tags: [i, i * 2]} after rows
  end repeat
end fill

on run n
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each row in rows
    add row's id to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run
